status: Predeclared independent experiment after the five regime candidates failed; no channel outcomes inspected
hypothesis: A simple trend follower with a wider price scale and no fixed target can retain large moves after costs; Fibonacci is not mandatory
budget: One fixed design, no parameter search or fallback configurations

design.name: channel_4h_20_10
design.entry: market on next five-minute open after a completed four-hour close beyond the preceding twenty-bar channel
design.exit: initial protective stop tightened only toward the latest completed ten-bar channel boundary, one tick outside
design.minimum_net_r_gate: not applicable without a fixed target; positive realized net expectancy is required

execution.funding: actual rates with five-minute opening price notional proxy
execution.entry_stop_ambiguity: stop-first; no credit for a favorable move before entry

historical_policy: Reserved older history only after development qualification and source freeze; not future evaluation; audit prior access and archive availability

uncertainty.method: circular contiguous seven-day blocks of daily account returns

publication: Publish all outcomes. A failed design is not promoted. A historically qualified design may proceed to Pine; native compilation and prospective evaluation remain separate gates.
